extras: The plugin is local-first and may require separate accounts or API keys for the underlying OpenAgent tools.
intentEvidence: OpenAgent Canvas is an Obsidian plugin for running local AI agent workflows from your vault and Canvas.
problem: Users need a way to execute complex, local AI agent tasks directly from the context of their Obsidian notes or Canvas diagrams.

relations.evidence: It connects Obsidian to a local OpenAgent daemon
Run OpenAgent tasks from Obsidian Canvas through a local Codex server and Codex Desktop.

summary: OpenAgent Canvas allows running local AI agent workflows from Obsidian Canvas nodes or notes by connecting to a local OpenAgent daemon.
